headline: Canada Unveils Budget to Support Economy Amid US Trade Friction
summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney's government unveiled a budget aimed at lessening economic dependence on the United States as trade tensions weigh on growth. The budget expands access to 30-year insured mortgages for homebuyers with larger down payments.
why: Fiscal policy adjustments and housing market measures directly influence Canadian consumer credit, banking stability, and overall macroeconomic growth.

impacts.name: Canada
impacts.why: New federal budget measures alter housing finance rules and trade resilience strategies in Canada.
